sections.heading: A systemic approach
sections.lead: Our potential for systemic change lies not in any single partnership, but in the shift from fragmented, bilateral service delivery to a single, integrated system that other actors can plug into and scale.

items.title: Changes the risk calculus
items.body: A pipeline of registered, tax-compliant, dispute-resilient groups turns an unknowable segment into a measurable, de-risked market for banks and insurers.

items.title: Feeds policy from practice
items.body: Real-time platform data on registration, exclusion and compliance gives government partners an evidence base to refine regulation — moving policy from reactive to informed.

items.title: Builds local capability
items.body: Training community leaders as literacy and mediation champions embeds capacity within communities rather than concentrating it in CECF.

sections.heading: What we measure, and why
rows: Not applications filed. Only the certificate counts.
A referral is not an outcome. An open account is.
The number most programmes avoid publishing.
Including those that failed and went to court.
So a funder can compare us honestly with alternatives.

sections.heading: Built to last
prose: Our sustainability case is stronger than a typical time-bound programme because it is built on diversified, self-generating revenue streams rather than dependence on a single funding source.
ticks: **The platform already generates its own revenue.** A modest user fee to access and use the application gives the core service a built-in commercial base independent of grant cycles.
**Funding scales reach, not day-to-day operations.** External funding expands the platform’s beneficiary base nationally, strengthening its commercial value as it grows.

**Diversified income reduces single-point-of-failure risk.** User fees, private-sector sponsorships, advertising and potential referral fees or data products give CECF multiple independent revenue legs.

sections.body: **In short:** our model shifts from impact that must be re-funded to impact that funds itself.
